# Skay Crafts

> Skay Crafts designs and builds digital systems — custom software, booking platforms, admin dashboards, integrations and automation — together with the digital experiences and brand systems around them. Founded on 16 April 2026 by Akshaya A and Syed Muhith Ibrahim R, based in Chennai, India, working globally. Tagline: "Building Beyond Limits."

Skay Crafts works from the workflow back to the technology. Projects usually span more than one discipline: the software a business runs on, the experience its customers see, the integrations that connect the two, and the identity around all of it. Strategy, design, development, integration and deployment are handled by one team.

## What we build

- **Digital systems**: custom platforms built around a business's own workflow — bookings, operations, billing, inventory, role-based admin, internal tools and SaaS products.
- **Digital experiences**: websites and digital products designed to convert and to keep working as the business changes shape.
- **Automation**: workflows and integrations that remove repetitive operational work, with AI applied where it removes real effort.
- **Brand systems**: identity, collateral and signage across screen, print, premises and vehicle — including logo design, name boards, stickering and car badges.

Digital growth work — SEO, local SEO, Google Business Profile, paid and social campaigns — is run alongside the build rather than handed to a separate agency.

## Capabilities

Custom software, admin systems, booking engines, internal tools, SaaS products, dashboards, payments, billing and POS, inventory, CRM, lead management, reporting, REST APIs, property and third-party system integration, webhooks, analytics, authentication and role-based access, cloud deployment, AI and automation.

## Where we work

- **Hospitality** — direct booking, guest experience, operational software. Evidence: The Roost, CornerStay.
- **Retail and automotive** — stock-led websites, lead capture, CRM, physical identity. Evidence: HiOnWheels.
- **Startups and SMEs** — custom software, internal platforms, SaaS, automation. Evidence: VAPR (in development).
- **Professional practices** — web presence, enquiry workflows, business automation. Evidence: Farook J Basha.

## Projects

- [The Roost](https://theroostsrh.com/): boutique stay in Nungambakkam, Chennai. Website, booking experience, enquiry management and operations support.
- [CornerStay](https://cornerstay.in/): serviced apartments in Coimbatore. Website and booking system covering nightly, weekly and monthly stays.
- [HiOnWheels](https://hionwheels.com/): luxury pre-owned car dealership in Chennai. Website and inventory presentation, plus brand identity, vehicle graphics and digital marketing.
- [PlayZoo](https://playzoo.in/): indoor gaming and pickleball centre in Chennai. Website and digital marketing.
- [Farook J Basha](https://farookjbashadop.com/): portfolio for a cinematographer and director of photography.
- VAPR: in development.
- Dawood Decors: identity work.

## Process

Understand → Define → Design → Build → Connect → Scale. Business, customers, workflows and constraints first; architecture and product strategy second; UX, interface and brand third; then software, integrations and automation; then APIs, payments, property systems, CRM and analytics; then optimisation, support and future development.

## Technology

React, Next.js, Node.js, Python, PostgreSQL, Supabase, REST APIs, cloud hosting, and AI-assisted development tools. The stack is chosen per project and is a consequence of the problem rather than the starting point.
